combat:cleanse: Cleanse removes the listed statuses from you at once: Immobilize or Shock. Removing Immobilize or Shock frees you for the rest of this turn, and a Shock cleanse can be played while Shocked.
keyword:retaliate: Until the start of your next turn, an enemy whose melee attack hits you takes the Retaliate amount. Block and Stoneskin absorb Retaliate damage. Expose does not increase Retaliate damage.
Melee means a melee attack or any attack made from a tile next to you. Retaliate triggers once per enemy attack. Several Retaliates add damage together. Shock and Push use the largest amounts.
An enemy defeated by Retaliate pays its normal rewards but does not refund a Card Play.
Until your next turn, each enemy that hits you up close takes that much damage and the listed effects.
an illusion's Retaliate triggers once per enemy attack.

grimoire_paragraphs.frost_armor: Each layer cancels 1 direct hit, then breaks. Ground damage, Collision and traps bypass Crystal Mantle.

relic_descriptions.funeral_bell: When an enemy dies with 2 or more different statuses, such as @term(expose) and @term(shock), each adjacent enemy gains the same statuses.
relic_descriptions.coffin_nails: When an enemy attack hits your @term(block) and deals no @term(health) damage, the attacker gains @term(expose) 2.
